snippet.title: Loftia Hanging Gardens Trailer
snippet.description: Loftia is a cozy multiplayer world where you can build towards a brighter, more sustainable future! This trailer reveals a first look at gameplay with new features like community farming, fishing, cave exploration, gliding and mini-games, as well as brand new areas for players to explore. https://store.steampowered.com/app/2320980/Loftia/ #indiegames #mmo #cozygames
